annotations.title: Waiver Targets — Sleeper trending adds with their Kalshi markets

description: Use for "who is everyone adding off waivers" and "trending waiver adds this week". Sleeper's most-added players in the last 24 hours with what Kalshi is pricing each at this week; pass position, and a Sleeper username + league to see only players still available. Market data only.

league.description: League name (partial) or id, when the user is in several.

limit.description: Max players (default 10). Values above 25 are clamped to 25.

position.description: Optional position filter. One of: QB · RB · WR · TE.

sleeper_username.description: Sleeper username — with it, players already rostered in your league are left out.
